versions.title: Special Edition, the last build before the Anniversary update (2021)
versions.source: Depot manifests from a community Steam downgrade shell script's per-game block for Skyrim Special Edition, contributed 2026-11-06. The three content depots are the ones Steam installs for the base game; Skyrim SE has no separate DLC depots, so this is the whole install. NOT yet verified against a download — confirm SkyrimSE.exe reports 1.5.97.0 after switching and move this note.
